messages:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026.04.20 -> prod done, kicking off postdeploy smoke: prefill, proxy, embed :rocket:
maria: prefill p95 in eu2 spiked to 900ms at 3123456710, small OOM on one pod
kevin: seeing kube events: Warning OOMKilled pod/prefill-zz 1m kubelet
sre-oncall: throttling synths to 1 zone and setting synth-jitter=120s while we triage
maria: can we soft-pin eu2 pool to previous image and set batch_size override to 10? avoids full rollback
release-manager: prefer soft-pin + throttle; we'll only rollback if client errors increase >0.5%
kevin: patch applied to eu2: imageOverride=v2026.04.18, batch_size=10; controller cycled 3 pods :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: prefill p95 back to ~140ms, no new OOMs in 3m. monitoring for 30m
maria: filing INF-2026-207 to track root cause and follow-ups (mem profiling + warmup staggering)
release-manager: add a one-line note to release notes: "Transient prefill memory pressure in EU2 during postdeploy synthetic warmup; mitigated by soft-pin and synth throttling; no customer impact."
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke summary: eu2 prefill degraded -> mitigated by pin+throttle; no rollback; INF-2026-207 created
sre-oncall: will lift pin after 8h if stable, will re-run controlled synth burst before unpin
maria: thanks, marking for morning triage
